Estimating prevalence

How many samples for a target margin of error, and the estimate with its confidence interval.

design_precision()
Calculate sample size for a target margin of error when estimating prevalence
estimate_prevalence()
Estimate prevalence and its precision

Testing against a threshold

Is prevalence above (or below) a decision threshold, such as the WHO pfhrp2/3 deletion threshold?

design_threshold()
Calculate sample size to detect a prevalence above or below a threshold
test_threshold()
Test whether prevalence is above or below a decision threshold

Comparing two groups

Does prevalence differ between two groups, such as two regions?

design_difference()
Calculate sample size to detect a difference in prevalence between two groups
test_difference()
Test whether prevalence differs between two groups

Costing a study

estimate_cost()
Estimate total study cost
